# Assets · Logos

2 files under `assets/Logos/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for plant_efficiency_header_logo.png>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

SABIC and product marks — copy, never redraw. `sabic_logo.svg` is the SABIC Arabic + Latin wordmark in two inks (#0047BB blue, #FFA300 orange) for the header's right side. `plant_efficiency_header_logo.png` is the PLANT EFFICIENCY product lockup (factory illustration + wordmark in primary_blue) for the header's left side; it is a 2x PNG render of the source `header/sabic_logo.svg`, whose embedded raster the asset store cannot keep.
